verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev workflows are written as plain async TypeScript/JavaScript (and Python via extension) functions with no YAML/DSL, using checkpoint-resume for durability (no determinism constraints), retries, and waitpoints — validated by both docs and community devs who moved from GUI/DSL tools (n8n) to code. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of 'automatic checkpointing' correctness at scale, and broader language support beyond TS/Python.
